basic_profile.bio: An avid NBA fan and a dedicated member of the UrgotMains community, I spend most of my time juggling between work and my hobbies. Originally from Toronto, Canada, I work as a software developer during the day and unwind by watching basketball games and playing League of Legends in the evenings. I'm single and enjoy attending live music events, especially Foo Fighters concerts. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a degree from the University of Toronto. My expertise lies in software development, particularly in web technologies. I also have a keen interest in basketball, which I've followed closely since my teenage years, both through watching games and engaging in online sports communities.
